verdict: Lead cost is rising and several planned workstreams are overdue.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 123 leads at $9.43 each, but the trend within that window is moving in the wrong direction — cost per lead jumped 57% and lead volume fell 17% in the most recent 7 days compared to the 7 days before. The primary driver is creative fatigue on your main Meta campaign, which absorbed 94% of all ad spend this period with no rotation in place; site traffic held steady, which means the drop is happening at the conversion stage, not the awareness stage. Separately, a number of program milestones — including landing pages, search campaigns, and nurture sequences — are overdue and their absence is compressing overall performance. Ad creative is being refreshed now, and the overdue workstreams are being escalated to resolve this week; you should see cost per lead stabilize and additional channels begin contributing in the next reporting period.
